voice_176:r_70b9c4b9f1f37eff.text: I won't give you time to regret it!

voice_176:r_9fcb3754cb1773c7.text: I'll erase every last atom of you!

voice_176:r_3559d2fad32c2435.text: Know the full measure of my power!

voice_176:r_cbab0f4720e1fcf1.text: I, the Space Demon King, face you!

voice_176:r_0bbe0b4f5364e732.text: Before my dark,\nnot one ray shines!

voice_176:r_5dda5198137cb02a.text: Only the strong survive the cosmos!

voice_176:r_e20bfd42ad95a3c9.text: Space Demon King!\nI am the cosmos!

voice_176:r_0f58a8822381e57f.text: My power is infinite! Behold it!

voice_176:r_b42ab697149a7c8a.text: This time, I'll finish you for good!

voice_176:r_30fad37a42bd3ad3.text: Tetsujin! This shall be your grave!

voice_176:r_80a0b2a84e05d81a.text: This is the end, Black Ox!

voice_176:r_4a9ac1dff86506d9.text: Gura...! At least, a swift death...!

voice_176:r_924516c8de2b5342.text: In Zul's stead,\nI grant you death!

voice_176:r_da1174533722333f.text: Love is naught before endless dark!

voice_176:r_fdeb8162976e72c1.text: Not even Getter rays reach my dark!

voice_176:r_0fadb5c26df92b42.text: A light god is weak before my dark!

voice_176:r_6b15af9a0057cdc8.text: Even gods bow before the Demon King!

voice_176:r_af884a6b11dff121.text: Machine angel, sink into the void!

voice_176:r_dc8701f6bcb9904f.text: I'll split you clean in two!

voice_176:r_9e0c80ac7e33b459.text: I'll carve your very soul to pieces!

voice_176:r_8f60f6fc86db3107.text: Then let me show you my power.

voice_176:r_b1de76a75a253c13.text: A reward for coming to die, fool.

voice_176:r_128c35bf3e0e394c.text: You can't flee the palm of my hand.

voice_176:r_5213c17e13b23de0.text: I'm growing tired of your face.

voice_176:r_38fdff9483e9245c.text: Learn the folly of defying me.

voice_176:r_9680dcd0fddcfcc7.text: Let me show you how to attack!

voice_176:r_3dbeead1bd3164ef.text: In this cosmos,\nthere is no escape!

voice_176:r_98d15b8cc09bc915.text: Where to? Your grave is right here!

voice_176:r_ac341e7976e88f0b.text: I shall lend you my power!

voice_176:r_cdbd128a5b4127cc.text: Such a weak attack?\nI'll block it!

voice_176:r_b1f8ec192b9c083a.text: Very well. I'll let you go for now.

voice_176:r_a007f9ab9cf048b3.text: So you do use your head in battle.

voice_176:r_ddafde4b065ced49.text: A petty trick to deceive my eyes...!

voice_176:r_3304412ac41f47a6.text: What's wrong? Fear made you tremble?

voice_176:r_0c0775e051211840.text: Those eyes of yours must be blind.

voice_176:r_a2afffe1c396f0b3.text: You can't even lay a hand on me.

voice_176:r_13c25fbdfddc8a24.text: I am darkness!\nYou cannot catch me!

voice_176:r_42ba1ecb310b4bd7.text: Fool! You call that an attack!

voice_176:r_d692f1d420460a47.text: Fuhahaha! First, you must hit me!

voice_176:r_68f2dfab20a4a30e.text: What now, boy!\nCan that beat me?!

voice_176:r_9cedad8237480563.text: A mere Black Ox\nis no match for me!

voice_176:r_a03fabecba1508ca.text: Gura! Come back to your father now!

voice_176:r_2c9d94ba13c5fc50.text: What a pointless thing to do!

voice_176:r_a77f4913375098d2.text: You can't pierce my dark barrier!

voice_176:r_70451ffbabe2f876.text: Heh heh.\nA mere pebble in the sea.

voice_176:r_69dfa1659715e2fa.text: Do you grasp how powerless you are?

voice_176:r_d996fd6d4ef5b329.text: Struggle on.\nThe void will take you.

voice_176:r_8ab47a28f99ef565.text: I can practically feel your despair.

voice_176:r_04e815a8d425827d.text: Hurry. Let darkness end your pain!

voice_176:r_d89011fe3e5d082a.text: Will you still resist in vain?!

voice_176:r_3c5b0c2ac812d5de.text: Damn you! You still won't give up?!

voice_176:r_5b9e8897190892eb.text: You dare affront Space Demon King!

voice_176:r_cb846feec748c2e3.text: Curse you, you brat from Earth!

voice_176:r_c958860b0676b1f5.text: Black Ox...! You are an eyesore!

voice_176:r_9b9726b1872759d6.text: Life fears no dark! Still unbowed?!

voice_176:r_d0372a183d2007ad.text: Even now, you still mean to resist?!

voice_176:r_381992c5d8224937.text: Curse you! Curse you!\nNo more mercy!

voice_176:r_f1e7ed9e5874aba5.text: Space Demon King!\nI know no defeat!

voice_176:r_fc25e66a86fc2c85.text: You...!\nI'll bury you at full force!

voice_176:r_774a9ab4d8fd5351.text: Gura, leave the rest to me.

voice_176:r_d3f01de714c015bd.text: Fine. This once, have it your way.

voice_176:r_7d2617c809fead70.text: Long play harms health. Rest awhile.
